description: Pinned Quantum-L9/l9-ci-core revision whose release engine (tools/l9_release) `make release DRY_RUN=1` runs locally. `make release DISPATCH=1` dispatches the release schedule hosted by runner_repository (the factory, which holds the repo-birth App credential), which calls Core's reusable release-runner.yml; it never dispatches Core directly. Cursor-Governance holds no release engine of its own. Re-pin by changing revision to a Core main commit that carries tools/l9_release.
